data.definition: stratlab/corrected.py (see its docstring): minute bars of both eras mapped per session onto official NSE prints x F(d) (splits / bonuses / consolidations / rights / demergers; dividends NOT back-adjusted = as-traded prices); affine repair of rupee-subtracted dividends; Kite's stale 09:15 bar on special pre-open days dropped; sessions whose shape disagrees with the official prints (> 1.5 % off, o/h/l ratios > 0.5 % apart) EXCLUDED; unadjusted-volume windows rescaled and flagged; the 10 daily-file (nse_old) issues repaired by official_factor / applied_factor. Index bars (NIFTY 50, NIFTY BANK, VIX) unchanged.
data.universe_daily_2012_23: point-in-time NIFTY 100 membership from flowdata index_members (index_membership/index_members.csv.gz, reliable from 2012-01-02): a stock strategy may open a position on decision day D only if the stock is a NIFTY 100 constituent in force on D (replaces the turnover top-100 of the original 2012-23 round); event strategies keep their point-in-time top-500 universe
data.universe_minute: today's 97 NIFTY-100 names (minute data exists only for them): the minute re-run remains SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED, as before
data.validation: all 119 minute-era rows of bar_adjustment_issues.csv pass corrected.validate() (overnight ratio = official gap / official factor; additive offsets < 0.2 % of price; seam 2023-11-09/10 for IOC / ONGC / PETRONET within 0.5 % of the official gap)

not_rerun.option / VRP strategies: they read only index bars and NSE option files, which the correction does not change: their results are unchanged by construction (VRP-STRANGLE-016-WINGED reported as before)

hypotheses.rule: the SAME strategies with the SAME code, parameters and gates; nothing is added, dropped or tuned. They are NOT new trials: ledger rows get stage 'corrected_rerun' / 'corrected_final' / 'corrected_oos' and the same params fingerprint, and are NOT added to N for the DSR.
hypotheses.tfgrid: all 668 grid combos (38 rules x 8 timeframes x universes) + 608 natives with the 1:3 bracket and Rs 10 lakh accounts exactly as prereg/tfgrid_v1.json

judgement.bug_rule: if Part 1 finds a simulator bug, the corrected ENGINE's result stands for every affected strategy and the report says so explicitly
judgement.dsr: deflated Sharpe with the SAME N as before the re-run (variants 2023-26 in trials_v2.csv, which the re-run does not increase)
judgement.final_one_look: a strategy that passes the corrected DISCOVERY screen opens its FINAL (2025-12-17..2026-11-09) ONLY if its FINAL was never opened before on the 3-year data under any cost model, in any ledger (stratlab_cache/*/final_ledger.json, tfgrid/final_ledger.json, events_daily ledger); the look is written once to audit/ledgers/final_corrected.json. CONFIRMED = net > 0 and PF >= 1.05.
judgement.old_era: for every strategy that passed the 2023-26 screen before (original verdict PASSED SCREEN / CONFIRMED / REJECTED ON FINAL on bars3y, any tfgrid stage-1 passer) or passes now, plus SPECIAL: 2012-23 daily (protocol_oos.judge gates unchanged, corrected daily file, PIT NIFTY 100) where eligible, and 2016-23 minute (protocol_min_oos gates unchanged, corrected old minute view; its dirty-link exclusion = the original dirty set plus the session after every excluded session). One judgement each, written to audit/ledgers/oldera_*_corrected.json; the original one-look ledgers are not touched and their verdicts are reported next to it.
judgement.opened_finals: a FINAL that was already opened is recomputed on corrected data and reported side by side; the ORIGINAL look stands (it is not a fresh look) unless bug_rule applies
judgement.proven: FINAL-CONFIRMED on 2023-26 AND OOS-CONFIRMED on 2016-23 (tfgrid: also DSR >= 0.95), as before
judgement.result_of_record: the corrected-data result is the result of record for every strategy
judgement.screen_2023_26: protocol.screen unchanged: DISCOVERY 2023-11-10..2025-12-16 (first 70 % of the 726-session calendar; H1 to 2024-11-29, H2 from 2024-12-02); net > 0 in H1 and H2, PF >= 1.15, >= 150 (intraday) / 60 (positional) trades, top symbol <= 35 % of net (not for one-instrument strategies); 2 bps (index 1 bps) slippage, costs.py 2026; tfgrid: its own account screen unchanged

status_at_writing.corrected_results_seen: none (no strategy has been simulated on the corrected view)
status_at_writing.simulator_audit: refsim (independent engine) vs sim.py on 22 strategies x 97 symbols, DISCOVERY 2023-11-10..2025-12-16: every trade identical (fills, exits, qty, gross, cost) wherever both engines read a strategy's rule the same way; all differences traced to ambiguous one-line descriptions or undocumented hygiene filters, none to the engine. 30/30 hand-checked trades match the raw JSON rows and a manual Zerodha computation. Gross/mirror/look-ahead/benchmark checks are still running when this was written: if any of them finds a simulator BUG, the clause 'bug_rule' below applies.

title: Corrected-data re-run of every lab strategy (same hypotheses, not new trials)
why: User: 'Test all strategies with corrected data - this much of strategies won't fail, simulation trade may be mistaken.' Part 1 of the work audits the simulator independently; this file freezes how the re-run on CORRECTED data is done and judged, before any strategy is simulated on corrected data.
